summary: Every installation's sign-in page now gets its security update, including ones already up to date.

fixes.title: sign-in page updates on every installation
fixes.text: An installation that was already up to date did not move its sign-in page to the new version. It now does on its next update run.

fixes.title: sign-in page on supported .NET 10
fixes.text: The sign-in page now runs on .NET 10, the same as every Invardia product. Signing in works as before, with nothing to change in your tenant.
